username.title: Instagram username or email
username.description: The account to log in as.

code.title: 2FA code (optional)
code.description: 6-digit code, only if the account has two-factor auth enabled.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Route the login through an Apify proxy. RESIDENTIAL is strongly recommended — Instagram often blocks logins from datacenter IPs. Residential proxy is a paid Apify add-on.
